name: demo-playwright-rust-for-google-maps
summary: A Rust + playwright-rs test-pattern demo for Google Maps: real assertions, never executed against the live site.
description: This repo demonstrates playwright-rs syntax and interaction patterns against Google Maps using three real assertion-based test functions: a page title check, a search-updates-URL check, and a zoom-in-increases-URL-zoom-parameter check. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its services, including Google Maps, so this code is never compiled, checked, or run against the live site; see README.md and AGENTS.md.
